messages:
sarah: Heads-up — planning next RFC review for Thu 09:00 PT. Proposal: group related RFCs into two ~20m blocks (less context switching). Looking for reviewer availability and which RFCs should be batched.

matt: +1 to batching. I can do the earlier block but I'm offline after 10:30 PT.

nora: Sounds good. Authors: can you upload pre-reads by EOD Tue? We need slides + PR link + 3 quick questions you want answered.

sarah: Agreed — pre-read checklist below. Also thinking we do reviewer batching (pair 2 reviewers per block) so one stays focused on deep comments.

rohit: I can review serving/runtime. I prefer second block (later) if possible — timezone.

lee: I can cover ingestion/storage and prefer the earlier slot.

jia: I'll take the runtime RFC author for #342. I'll upload slides and the PR link by EOD Tue.

nora: Pre-read checklist (please copy into your PR description):
- slides <= 6 (PDF)
- one-paragraph summary + decision requested
- list of concrete questions (max 3)
- links to benchmarks / perf traces
- PR and design doc links

sarah: Draft run-of-show (we'll paste into the calendar event):
```
09:00 - 09:02  Quick intro & goals (sarah)
09:02 - 09:22  Block A: 20m (2 RFCs, 10m each) — ingestion + storage
09:22 - 09:25  3m buffer / quick notes
09:25 - 09:45  Block B: 20m (runtime + experiments infra)
09:45 - 09:50  Action items & owners
```

matt: Can we compress to single 15m RFCs if authors promise a 5-min lightning update? Helps fit a third small RFC.

sarah: Yes — we can make a 'lightning' lane. Authors must mark `lightning` in the pre-read.

jia: Uploaded: https://drive.google.com/xxx (slides + short summary) — label: runtime-342-preread.

rohit: Got it. I'll review the pre-read tonight.

nora: Calendar note: please set your RSVP. I'll lock order Tue 12:00 PT based on who RSVPs and author timezones.

lee: small ask — can we start with authors who need policy sign-off first? avoids back-and-forth later.

sarah: Good call. We'll prioritize policy-heavy RFCs in Block A.

calendar-bot: Event created — "RFC Review (2x20m blocks)" Thu 09:00 PT. Invitees: eng-reviewers, authors. Link: https://calendar.example.com/event/abc123

matt: :thumbsup:

sarah: Final note — if you can't attend, add a proxy reviewer in the comments and ping @nora so we can rebalance. Thanks all!"
